opening.argument: The video is presented as a ThePrint interview about the 2002 Gujarat riots and an army officer’s account of the response. Its substance is the response to those events: the speaker describes decisions about army deployment and assesses the administrative handling as a failure. The interview setting and ThePrint branding support that news presentation. The request to subscribe is ordinary audience engagement, not a request for money, private data, or financial participation. Nothing in the cited material establishes a financial solicitation or a promised outcome for viewers.

citations.quote: ex-AMU VC and Retd. Gen. Zameer Uddin Shah talks about the 2002 Gujarat riots
all three of us decided on the deployment of the army
It was a case of administrative failure total.
